params.caption: 🏆 Resident Evil Requiem is Golden Joysticks 2026 Game of the Year Capcom's Resident Evil Requiem took Ultimate Game of the Year at the Golden Joystick Awards 2026 and tied with Meccha Chameleon as the night's biggest winner. CD Projekt Red also picked up wins for The Witcher 4 and The Witcher 3 Remastered across the 25 categories. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 23:15 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👍 Like if Requiem deserved it · 💬 Who was your Game of the Year? #ResidentEvil #GoldenJoysticks #GamingNews
